editTierDialog.autoJoinRequirementsHint: When met, customers are automatically assigned this tier; when no longer met, they move to whichever tier (if any) they still qualify for. Leave blank to manage this tier manually only.
editTierDialog.gracePeriodHint: Once a customer enters this tier, they won't be moved down (or out of membership) for this many days even if they stop meeting the requirements above. Promotion to a higher tier is never delayed. Leave blank for no grace period.
